Quran timeline project at H:/DevProjects/quran-timeline/ is active research. API data fetched, methodology documented. This connects to PHILO venture's deep research and could bridge to CRYPTO (history of money) content.

Cross-venture experiments document defines 10 concrete experiments (Eid bundle, Web3 financing, cultural storytelling, etc.). None executed yet. These are pre-planned revenue opportunities waiting for execution.

Active code projects: Insectiles (TypeScript/Vite/React/PixiJS, 8.5/10 quality), RollON (deployed), hope-theory-hq (deployed Vercel), BugSmasher (case study written). Code Ninja has real project portfolio to show clients.

mistakes.content: Overbuilt infrastructure, under-deployed it: 7 profiles created but configs are 2-line stubs. 130 skills installed but none executable. 23 cron jobs generated but none scheduled. Factory built, assembly line not running.
mistakes.lesson: [LESSON] Always end each session with at least ONE operational output. Infrastructure without ops is theater. Next: deploy the minimum viable system first, then add complexity.

mistakes.content: Built entire model architecture around OpenRouter free models (Nemotron, Qwen Coder, DeepSeek R1) without verifying OpenRouter has credits. Only Gemini works. Architecture is theoretical, not operational.
mistakes.lesson: [LESSON] Verify API credit balances BEFORE architecting model assignments. Build around what works (Gemini), not what you wish worked (OpenRouter free tier). Check .env credits in the first 5 minutes of every session.

mistakes.content: ShadowNetwork has only 1 insight from the entire build. 7 sessions worth of work, 300+ files created, and almost nothing tagged. No bridges, no learnings, no mistakes documented. Memory pool empty.
mistakes.lesson: [LESSON] Tag every session output immediately. [LEARNED], [MISTAKE]+[LESSON], [CROSS_VENTURE] tags are not optional — they're the system's memory. Start tagging in the first message of every session.
